jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager
jobs.description:
Immigration / Work Authorization Notice: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States. iSpot is not able to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this position at this time.

iSpot competes for the best talent. Our compensation packages consist of salary and equity in one of Seattle’s hottest start-ups, as well as other standard benefits. Most importantly, we provide a really interesting working experience, and the chance to contribute to the success of something great.

What You’ll Be Part Of:

iSpot is the market leader in real-time TV ad measurement, providing the most comprehensive and actionable data to the advertising industry’s top brands, agencies, and media companies. We are seeking a seasoned and curious Senior Product Manager to join our team and help shape the next generation of identity-powered measurement across CTV and streaming.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role at the intersection of identity resolution, outcomes measurement, and performance optimization, a space that is evolving rapidly as the industry navigates privacy-first data collaboration. You will own and drive major product features end-to-end, partnering closely with engineering, data science, and go-to-market teams to build solutions that matter to our clients.

You are a product practitioner who thrives in complex, data-rich environments. You have hands-on experience with data clean rooms - such as Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) or Google Ads Data Hub (ADH) - and understand how identity underpins every layer of modern TV measurement. You are ready to lead, influence, and deliver.

Responsibilities:

Product Strategy and Roadmap: Lead the strategy and execution of major product features within iSpot’s identity and measurement portfolio. Influence broader product vision and align your roadmap with business goals and client needs.

Identity & Clean Room Expertise: Serve as the product owner for capabilities that leverage data clean rooms (e.g., AMC, ADH) and identity resolution frameworks to enable privacy-safe audience measurement and optimization. Define requirements and work with engineering and data science to bring these capabilities to life.

Market and Customer Research: Conduct in-depth research to understand the evolving identity landscape, competitive offerings, and client requirements. Use these insights to inform prioritization and product decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, design, data science, sales, and customer success to deliver high-quality products on time and within scope. Drive alignment across teams and keep stakeholders informed and engaged.

Customer Advocacy: Engage directly with customers and internal stakeholders to gather feedback and ensure that client needs are central to how we build. Be the voice of the customer on your product area.

Data-Driven Decision Making: Use data to justify direction, prioritize investments, and connect product decisions to measurable customer and commercial value. Define and track KPIs to measure feature success and drive continuous improvement.

Documentation and Communication: Lead the creation and maintenance of clear, accurate, and helpful product documentation. Present confidently to cross-functional teams and leadership, driving engagement and alignment.

Mentorship: Guide the development of Associate PMs and PMs on the team, sharing knowledge and contributing to a culture of craft and continuous learning.

Qualifications and Education Requirements:

- 4+ years of product management experience, with demonstrated mastery in product lifecycle management and a track record of shipping meaningful features in data-intensive environments.

- Deep knowledge of the identity ecosystem, including identity resolution methodologies, household and person-level identifiers, and the role of privacy-enhancing technologies in modern measurement.

- Strong understanding of CTV and streaming advertising measurement, including audience delivery, reach and frequency, and outcomes attribution across linear and digital video.

- Proven ability to influence broader product strategy and vision, aligning product decisions with business goals while navigating ambiguity and competing priorities.

- Strong technical and data acumen—comfortable leading productive conversations with engineering and data science teams on topics such as data modeling, API integrations, and probabilistic matching.

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present confidently to larger groups, drive engagement, and articulate complex concepts—such as identity linkage or incremental lift—to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Experience mentoring or guiding junior product managers is a plus.

- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Business); Master’s degree is a plus.

Preferred Experience:

- Familiarity with the IAB Tech Lab’s measurement and Open RTB standards and an interest in contributing to industry working groups.

- Experience at a measurement company, media company, agency, or adtech platform working on cross-screen or cross-platform audience products.

- Exposure to outcomes measurement, including sales lift, brand lift, or multi-touch attribution (MTA).

Target cash compensation range: $140,183 - $151,896 USD Annually

We are committed to providing competitive, market-informed compensation. The cash compensation above includes base salary, variable commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, all full time iSpotters are eligible to participate in iSpot’s equity plan to receive stock options. Non-exempt roles will also be eligible for (pre-approved) overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are influenced by different factors unique to each candidate, including their skills, experience, qualifications and other job-related reasons.

For more information on total rewards package, go HERE

Hybrid & Flexible Workplace Policy

iSpot supports a hybrid and flexible workplace. Depending on location and work responsibilities, employees may be designated as full-time or part-time office-based or a fully remote employee. A hybrid work schedule indicates that you work in the office some days and work from home other days. The best hybrid workplaces allow for flexibility while also encouraging consistency.

Those local or living in surrounding areas to one of our offices (Bellevue, WA or New York, NY) will work a hybrid schedule, coming into their local office 1-3 days a week. While those in a role, not office-based and located further away from our offices, will work a fully remote schedule. If you have questions regarding exact details of our hybrid & flexible workplace policy, please let your recruiter know and they will discuss with you further.

If you don't feel you met every single requirement for the role, don't rule yourself out. Please apply anyway!

iSpot is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please contact our HR team.

iSpot competes for the best talent. Our compensation packages consist of salary and equity in one of Seattle’s hottest start-ups, as well as other standard benefits. Most importantly, we provide a really interesting working experience, and the chance to contribute to the success of something great.

What You’ll Be Part Of:

iSpot.tv is changing how brands, agencies, and networks measure and assess the impact of TV advertising. The iSpot service connects TV advertising to actual business outcomes, empowering the world’s top brands to plan, measure, and optimize their TV campaigns and to understand their influence on business growth.

Our Operations team provides mission-critical support to our sales, customer success, and marketing teams. The Technical Program Manager (TPM) will own and drive the execution of core business system initiatives, applying program management rigor—such as comprehensive requirements gathering, roadmap planning, timeline tracking, and stakeholder communication—to bridge the gap between complex business needs and technical systems architecture. This is a fast-paced, high-impact role ideal for an analytical problem solver who thrives in a collaborative environment and can lead cross-functional initiatives from inception to delivery.

Responsibilities:

- Program Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional business stakeholders (e.g., Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product and Engineering) to scope strategic initiatives and author technical requirements, including Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and detailed user stories.

- Execution & Delivery: Lead the end-to-end execution of complex, technical projects by establishing project milestones, managing dependencies, proactively mitigating risks, and clearing blockers to ensure predictable, timely delivery.

- Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate regular syncs, communication channels, and status updates across technical and non-technical teams to maintain total alignment on system improvements and the overarching operational roadmap.

- System Optimization: Continuous evaluation of core systems to identify opportunities to maximize application capabilities, scale technical workflows, and improve productivity.

Qualifications and Education Requirements:

- Experience: 5–7 years of experience managing technical programs, complex software projects, or enterprise systems implementations.

- Proven track record of translating ambiguous business requests into structured, execution-ready technical documentation, such as system process maps and PRDs.

- Proficient in utilizing project management and issue-tracking platforms (e.g., JIRA) to drive engineering workflows and sprint cycles.

- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to listen intently, influence stakeholders, and communicate technical concepts.

- Strong ability to multitask, prioritize competing high-impact initiatives, and manage time effectively within a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

- A dedicated team player who excels at building consensus and driving collaboration across distinct internal teams.

Preferred Skills:

- Strong quantitative and data analysis skills, with experience leveraging system telemetry and application usage data and making data-driven roadmap decisions.

- Experience creating low-fidelity UX wireframes or interface mockups to effectively visualize user workflows and guide frontend adjustments.
